text:
ساون دا سو، بھدّ دے ترے
اسو دا ہک، جہڑا لاہ دیوے سک۔
romanized:
Sawan da sau, Bhadd de tré
Assu da hikk, jehra lah dévé sikk.
literal_en:
A hundred showers in Sawan (July and August), three in Bhado (August-September)
One in Assu (September-October), which will fulfil all desire.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
